confirm.title: Continue Webasto Connect setup
confirm.description: After approving the ThermoConnect association request in the Webasto app, continue to reload the integration. Pending device(s): {devices}

subscription_expiring.title: Webasto subscription for {device} expires soon
subscription_expiring.description: The Webasto ThermoConnect subscription of {device} expires on {expiration_date} ({days_left} days left). It does not renew automatically: renew it on My Webasto Connect. If it lapses, the service is suspended and a reactivation fee applies.

subscription_expired.title: Webasto subscription for {device} has expired
subscription_expired.description: The Webasto ThermoConnect subscription of {device} expired on {expiration_date}. The service is suspended until it is renewed on My Webasto Connect; a reactivation fee applies.

error.ratelimit: Rate limit exceeded - try again later

reauth_confirm.description: Enter the password for {email} to continue.
reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Webasto Connect account

create_timer.name: Create timer
create_timer.description: Creates a new simple timer for a Webasto device on its active output (heater or ventilation).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Webasto device to create the timer for.

line.name: Output
line.description: The output the timer runs on. Leave empty to use the active output (ventilation when ventilation mode is on, otherwise heater).

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Local clock time for the timer start (HH:MM). Seconds are optional.

repeat_days.name: Repeat days
repeat_days.description: Days when the timer should run. Leave empty for a non-repeating timer.

location.name: Location
location.description: Optional map location for the timer.

update_timer.name: Update timer
update_timer.description: Updates an existing simple timer by index. Only the fields provided in the action are changed; omitted fields keep their current value.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Webasto device that has the timer.

line.name: Output
line.description: The output the timer is on. Defaults to heater when left empty.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Local clock time for the timer start (HH:MM). Seconds are optional.

repeat_days.name: Repeat days
repeat_days.description: Days when the timer should run. Leave empty for a non-repeating timer.

location.name: Location
location.description: Optional map location for the timer. Cannot be used with Clear location.

delete_timer.name: Delete timer
delete_timer.description: Deletes a timer by index on the active output line (heater or ventilation mode).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Webasto device that has the timer.

timer_index.name: Timer index
timer_index.description: Zero-based index in the timer list of the active output line.

device_not_found.message: No Webasto device found with device ID {device_id}.

device_not_reported.message: The Webasto account no longer reports the device {device_name}.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Webasto Connect entry {entry_title} is not loaded. Check the integration and try again.

timers_not_supported.message: The installed pywebasto library does not support timers. Update the integration.

no_timers.message: There are no timers to change on this device.

invalid_timer_index.message: Invalid timer index {timer_index}. The valid range is 0 to {max_index} ({timer_count} timers).

invalid_start_time.message: Invalid start time {start_time}. Use the format HH:MM.

invalid_repeat_days.message: Repeat days must be a list of weekdays.

invalid_location.message: The location must be a map location with a latitude and a longitude.

location_with_coordinates.message: Location cannot be used together with latitude and longitude.

clear_location_with_coordinates.message: Clear location cannot be used together with latitude and longitude.

clear_location_with_location.message: Clear location cannot be used together with location.

incomplete_coordinates.message: Latitude and longitude must both be provided or both be omitted.

start_time_conversion_unavailable.message: The start time cannot be converted without the Home Assistant time zone.

missing_timer_values.message: A timer needs a start time, a duration and repeat days.

create_timer_failed.message: Could not create the timer because the request to the Webasto cloud failed. Try again later.

update_timer_failed.message: Could not update the timer because the request to the Webasto cloud failed. Try again later.

delete_timer_failed.message: Could not delete the timer because the request to the Webasto cloud failed. Try again later.

rate_limited.message: The Webasto cloud is limiting the number of requests. Try again later.
